title: Listen and Choose a Response — Exam Prep

questions.stem: Why don't we study together for the chemistry final?

options.A: Because the final is on Thursday.
options.B: I studied chemistry in high school.
options.C: Good idea. How about the library after lunch?
options.D: The library has a chemistry section.

questions.explanation: Accepting the suggestion and proposing a place and time is appropriate; the first distractor treats 'why' as a real question.
questions.speaker: f4
